source: Psi Wars - Card Set v0.4.xlsx (imported by tools/data/import_v04.py)

cards.name: Rupture Brute
cards.origin: Change Request 1 (new card; no art yet - the client draws a generated face)
cards.designNote: Vanilla red baseline; 3 Physical is intentionally strong but vulnerable to Psionic disorientation.

cards.name: Vesper Ripper
cards.text: Before combat dice, you may roll the red die as an ability roll: numeric even, +2 Physical; odd, -1 Physical. Until end of turn.
cards.designNote: Optional risk after blocks; a choice, not automatic random noise.

cards.name: Jingwa Psi Avenger
cards.text: When blocked, the defending player chooses: discard a Power card, or its defender loses 1 Physical until end of turn (minimum 1). If no Power card is available, choose the strength loss.
cards.designNote: Pressure both factions; defender can choose the less painful option.

cards.name: Marrow Parasite
cards.text: Mutation — After this unit or its Stack survives a blocked battle and destroys a Battle Unit under enemy control, compare that destroyed unit’s permanent strengths with this unit’s permanent strengths immediately before the battle. If its Physical was at least as high, gain +1 permanent Physical; otherwise, if its Psionic was higher, gain +1 permanent Psionic. For a destroyed Stack, choose one destroyed member.
cards.designNote: Predation-driven adaptation: larger prey drives growth; small prey cannot endlessly farm Physical. One Mutation per engagement.

cards.name: Psi Hatchling
cards.origin: Change Request 1 (new card; no art yet - the client draws a generated face)
cards.designNote: Vanilla blue baseline, no additional ability.

cards.name: Shadow Assassin
cards.text: Psionic X. When its X ability roll resolves, if the numeric result is 1 or 2, gain +1 Physical until end of turn.
cards.designNote: Low roll offers an alternate payoff; Lock-On has a real tradeoff.

cards.name: Siana Commander
cards.text: Mutation — At the end of a Battle phase in which another Creature under your control was destroyed, choose one Creature under your control that survived a blocked engagement this phase. If it lost a Psionic battle, it gains +1 permanent Psionic; otherwise it gains +1 permanent Physical. Once per phase across your Siana Commanders.
cards.designNote: Collective adaptation requires combat exposure; cannot evolve a creature that stays out of blocked battles.

cards.name: Trangarey Scythe
cards.text: When attacking, if you declared at least two other attacking units, this gains +1 Physical for that battle phase.
cards.designNote: Attack wide or preserve bodies; requires real board investment.

cards.name: Acorbeac Destroyer
cards.text: When Stacked with a Robot, gain +1 Cyber; when Stacked with a Creature, gain +1 Psionic. While Stacked only.
cards.designNote: Two colors rather than all four, modest stack payoff.

cards.name: Veydran Executioner
cards.text: When this or its Stack destroys an Battle Unit under enemy control in Physical combat, deal 1 damage to that opponent’s Lab. Once per battle.
cards.designNote: Chip damage only on destruction, no attack loop.

cards.name: Javarow Protector
cards.text: While Stacked with a Robot, prevent the first 1 point of ability damage to either member of this Stack each Battle phase.
cards.designNote: Supports the mechanical partner instead of searching repeatedly.

cards.name: Kyler Revenant
cards.text: Once per turn, when this Stack destroys an unit under enemy control in Physical combat, draw a Battle card.
cards.designNote: Card advantage requires risking a Stack; no generic repeated tutoring.

cards.name: Lodner Predator
cards.text: Once per turn, when this or its Stack destroys an unit under enemy control in Physical combat, deplete one ready CU of that opponent, if any.
cards.designNote: No repeatable permanent CU lock. Disruption is temporary.

cards.name: Third I
cards.text: When Stacked with a Creature, choose +1 Psionic or +1 Physical for the Stack until it separates.
cards.designNote: Choose adaptive stance at declaration.

cards.name: Zomber Mercenary
cards.text: Psionic X. If Stacked with a Robot, you may set X to 3 instead of making its ability roll.
cards.designNote: Partner controls risk versus consistency.

cards.name: Davileam Commander

protocols.Assault: choose up to two attacking Robots under your control at declaration; each gains +1 Physical for this Battle phase.
protocols.Guard: choose up to two defending Robots under your control at declaration; each gains +1 Physical for this Battle phase.
protocols.Precision: one Robot under your control may Calibrate its Physical die each Battle phase.

cards.text: Protocol — Assault: choose up to two attacking Robots under your control at declaration; each gains +1 Physical for this Battle phase. Guard: choose up to two defending Robots under your control at declaration; each gains +1 Physical for this Battle phase. Precision: one Robot under your control may Calibrate its Physical die each Battle phase.
cards.implementation: v0.4: Protocol → ProtocolBoost; Protocol → ProtocolBoost; Protocol → ProtocolPrecision
cards.designNote: Select one public mode, not all three. Only one Davileam protocol grants benefits per player.

cards.name: Hydra Bot
cards.text: While equipped, gain +1 Cyber.
cards.designNote: Equipping costs a real card and CU investment.

cards.name: Loquidor Stalker
cards.text: During the Power window on defense, pay P1: if unengaged, assign this as defender to an unblocked attacker against your Lab. Once per Battle phase.
cards.designNote: Reassignment is paid and only applies against unblocked attacker.

cards.name: Nomis Analyzer
cards.text: When created, look at an opponent’s hand. Once per your Battle phase before dice, pay G1 to give one Robot under your control +1 Physical for its battle.
cards.designNote: Information reveals a plan, not a free repeated discard.

cards.name: Scout Drone
cards.origin: Change Request 1 (new card; no art yet - the client draws a generated face)
cards.designNote: Vanilla green baseline; no extra free scry.

cards.name: Scrap Hulk
cards.origin: Change Request 1 (new card; no art yet - the client draws a generated face)
cards.designNote: Vanilla purple baseline mirrors Rupture Brute, not an ability unit.

cards.name: Therabot Seeker
cards.text: Lock-On (deplete G1).
cards.designNote: Local control; cannot alter a roll outside this unit’s own opposing engagement.

cards.name: Cyber Onslaught
cards.text: +1 Cyber for Robots or Cyborgs.
cards.designNote: Useful in mirror and against Cyborgs; inexpensive specialty upgrade.

cards.name: Kranthard Armour
cards.text: +2 Physical for any Battle Unit. Relocate — deplete R/P 1.
cards.designNote: Flexible heavy armor pays for flexibility through a burn and paid relocation.

cards.name: Mental Shield
cards.text: +2 Psionic for Creatures or Cyborgs. Relocate — deplete B/P 1.
cards.designNote: Flexible specialty protection, paid movement limits reuse.

cards.name: Physical Augmentation
cards.text: +1 Physical for any Battle Unit.
cards.designNote: Mixed R/P 2: pay RR, RP or PP; cheaper in color requirements, only +1 Physical.

cards.name: Psi Bolster
cards.text: +1 Psionic for Creatures or Cyborgs. Before its combat dice, you may replace this bonus with +1 Physical until end of turn.
cards.designNote: Convert the boost instead of stacking two bonuses.

cards.name: Vegian Cyber Shield
cards.text: +1 Cyber. Once per Battle phase, ignore an opponent’s Obliterate effect on this unit’s Cyber die. Relocate — deplete G/P 1.
cards.designNote: Specialized shield, not free to move between combats.

cards.name: Bio Pulse
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to up to two Creatures or Cyborgs under enemy control.
cards.origin: Change Request 1 (new card; no art yet - the client draws a generated face)
cards.designNote: Explicit separate burn and deplete pools. Flexible but requires two distinct resources.

cards.name: Creature Regenerate
cards.text: Return a Creature or Cyborg with printed total cost 3 or less and printed Psionic above 0 (X qualifies) from your discard to your Lab. It returns at printed strengths with a permanent Reanimated modifier: +2 Physical and −2 Psionic (minimum 0).
cards.designNote: Pulse-speed zombie reanimation; a permanent modification, not a Mutation. No old modifiers or Equipment; cannot enter an already assigned engagement.

cards.name: Equipment Hunter
cards.text: Search your Battle Deck for an Equipment, reveal it, put it in your hand, then shuffle.
cards.designNote: Operation; one CU of any type, no burn.

cards.name: Equipment Mechanic
cards.text: Choose an Equipment in your discard and a legal host under your control. As an additional cost, pay that Equipment’s full printed creation cost. Return it directly to play attached to the chosen host.
cards.designNote: Operation; burn any 1 plus the Equipment’s normal cost, all from distinct ready CUs. No extra movement fee or discounts.

cards.name: High-Energy Pulse
cards.text: Choose up to two units under enemy control with Cyber above 0. They cannot attack or defend this turn; remove them from current battles if engaged.
cards.designNote: Narrow shutdown with counterplay.

cards.name: Overload Strike
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to a Battle Unit or 2 damage to a Lab.
cards.origin: Change Request 1 (new card; no art yet - the client draws a generated face)
cards.designNote: Avoid 9 points of cheap Lab burn.

cards.name: Robo Refurb
cards.text: Creation only. Return a Robot with printed total creation cost 3 or less from your discard to play at its printed strengths.
cards.designNote: Repair restores printed stats, not old permanent modifiers; no expensive unit cheating.

cards.name: Static Burst
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to up to two Robots or Cyborgs under enemy control.
cards.origin: Change Request 1 (new card; no art yet - the client draws a generated face)
cards.designNote: Targeted answer; no whole-board shutdown.

cards.name: Grankor Stasis Field
cards.text: Contain one Battle Unit under enemy control. While contained, it cannot attack, defend, use or grant abilities, be chosen by a Power or unit ability, or be used to pay a cost. At each of its owner’s Cleanups, roll red: free it if current Physical + numeric roll is at least 5; free it after its second failed escape.
cards.designNote: Protection and cost restriction are specific to Grankor; ordinary containment need not be immune to effects.

cards.name: Creation Oracle
cards.text: Search Resource Deck for Creation Unit of Your Choice. Place in Lab. Shuffle Deck.
cards.designNote: Keep original resource rules.

cards.name: Resource Fortification
cards.text: Attach to a CU during Creation. When that CU would be destroyed to pay W, deplete it instead and discard this Fortification.
cards.origin: Change Request 1 (new card; no art yet - the client draws a generated face)
cards.designNote: Single-use protection prevents recurrent white discount.

cards.name: Bio-Acceleration
cards.designNote: Keep original resource rules.

cards.name: Digital Splicing
cards.designNote: Keep original resource rules.

cards.name: Material Animation
cards.designNote: Keep original resource rules.

cards.name: Neurogenesis
cards.designNote: Keep original resource rules.

cards.name: Fengar Berserker
cards.text: Psionic X. On an ability roll of face 6, gain +1 Physical until end of turn.
cards.designNote: High variance finisher. Potential 4 Physical on turn 4.

cards.name: Garilian Seer
cards.text: Psionic X. After its X ability roll, you may discard a Battle card to give another untrapped unit under your control +1 Physical until end of turn.
cards.designNote: A choice between low roll insurance and raising Psychic strength.

cards.name: Warend Reaper
cards.text: When created, you may Cannibalize another Creature or Cyborg under your control. If you do, this gains +1 permanent Physical.
cards.designNote: A permanent feeding buff, not a Mutation; the destroyed body is the cost.

cards.name: Bellarn Cyborg
cards.text: Before combat dice, you may give this -1 Cyber and +1 Physical until end of turn.
cards.designNote: Clear physical tradeoff.

cards.name: Urilian Overlord
cards.text: Cyber X. If Stacked with a Robot, you may reroll this X ability roll once; keep the new result.
cards.designNote: An actual risky Robot-adjacent roll for Lock-On matchups.

cards.name: Veeda Commander
cards.text: Once per Battle phase across your Veeda Commanders, when you form a Stack, choose +1 Cyber or +1 Psionic for that Stack until it separates. If its partner is equipped, you may choose +1 Physical instead.
cards.designNote: Reward stacking without blanket Physical boost.

cards.name: Pencar Inferno
cards.text: Once per Battle phase before its dice, pay P1: gain +1 Physical until end of turn.
cards.designNote: Stable unit with paid conversion; no random X.

cards.name: Stealth Skyfire
cards.text: When attacking, cannot be blocked by a lone unit with printed Physical 1. Stacks may block normally.
cards.designNote: Threat that avoids a support-unit block, not all defenders.

cards.name: Tricapia Guardian
cards.text: When defending, may Calibrate its Physical die.
cards.designNote: Late defensive anchor with conditional die insurance.

cards.name: Xardy Piercer
cards.text: When equipped and fighting a blocked battle, gain +1 Physical for that battle.
cards.designNote: Equipment payoff limited to blocked battles; direct Lab damage unchanged.

cards.name: Mental Disrupter
cards.text: Choose up to two units under enemy control with Psionic above 0. They cannot attack or defend this turn; remove them from current battles if engaged.
cards.designNote: Symmetric narrow safety valve, not a faction-wide hate card.

cards.name: Patchwork Initiate
cards.designNote: Vanilla three-stat one-drop; test cheap Stacking carefully.

cards.name: Signal Mite
cards.text: When created, look at the top two cards of your Battle Deck and return them in either order.
cards.designNote: Trade one stat for information; playable across strategies.

cards.name: Assembly Wisp
cards.text: When created, you may relocate one Equipment between legal units under your control, paying its listed move cost. If you moved it, look at the top card of your Battle Deck.
cards.designNote: Movement uses ordinary Creation timing and costs.

cards.name: Targeting Node
cards.text: During a blocked battle involving another Robot under your control, pay G1: that Robot may Calibrate its Cyber die. Once per Battle phase.
cards.designNote: An inexpensive support node; narrower than Physical calibration.

cards.name: Spore Larva
cards.text: When destroyed, choose another Creature under your control: it gains +1 Physical until end of turn (maximum +1 from Spore Larva per unit per turn).
cards.designNote: Death trigger forces sequencing; weaker attacker.

cards.name: Mind Leech
cards.text: When this attacks and is blocked, you may give it -1 Psionic and +1 Physical until end of turn.
cards.designNote: Risk: zero Psionic disorientation versus psychic defenders.

cards.name: Brood Carrier
cards.text: When created, you may reveal another Creature in your hand. If you do, look at the top two Battle cards; return them in either order.
cards.designNote: Consistency without extra cards or bodies.

cards.name: Relay Chimera
cards.text: While Stacked with a Creature, gain +1 Psionic. While Stacked with a Robot, gain +1 Cyber.
cards.designNote: Flexible hybrid; zero-Psi exposure outside stack.

cards.name: Fabricator Drone
cards.text: Once during your Creation, deplete this ready, untrapped unit: the next Equipment you create this turn costs 1 fewer P (minimum total cost 1).
cards.designNote: Trade attack for discount; one discount per Equipment.

cards.name: Scrap Harvester
cards.text: Once during Creation, if an Equipment is in your discard, you may pay P1 and remove that Equipment from the game to draw a Battle card.
cards.designNote: Resource conversion competes with recursion.

cards.name: Vector Sentinel
cards.text: When defending, before combat dice, you may Calibrate your Physical die.
cards.designNote: Reliable defender, weaker ceiling.

cards.name: Countermeasure Array
cards.text: Lock-On (deplete G1).
cards.designNote: Each copy can pay for its own engagement; no player-wide limit.

cards.name: Railgun Overseer
cards.text: When created, choose another Robot under your control. While that Robot remains equipped and both are untrapped, this gains +1 Physical.
cards.designNote: Clear vulnerable link; no repeated target selection.

cards.name: Foundry Titan
cards.text: When created, return one Equipment from your discard to your hand. If you control no other Robot, skip this ability.
cards.designNote: Finisher that rewards infrastructure, not automatic infinite discounts.

cards.name: Grid Marshal

protocols.Guard: when this defends, it may Calibrate its Physical die.

cards.text: Protocol — Scan: this gains Lock-On (deplete G1). Guard: when this defends, it may Calibrate its Physical die.
cards.designNote: Personal operating modes, visible before combat; no remote Lock-On.

cards.name: Swarm Caller
cards.text: When created, reveal the top three cards of your Battle Deck. You may put one Creature with printed total cost 1 into your hand; return the rest to the bottom in any order.
cards.designNote: Find cheap bodies; deck construction determines reliability.

cards.name: Carrion Sprinter
cards.text: When another Creature under your control is destroyed during your Battle phase, this gains +1 Physical until end of turn, once per turn.
cards.designNote: Temporary payoff for losses, not permanent escalation.

cards.name: Morphic Adept
cards.text: Adaptive shift: before its combat dice, you may move 1 point of its Psionic strength to Physical or 1 Physical to Psionic until end of turn (Physical minimum 1).
cards.designNote: Player-controlled conversion, no random requirement.

cards.name: Chitin Weaver
cards.text: Mutation — After this unit survives a blocked battle in which it lost the Psionic battle, it gains +1 permanent Psionic.
cards.designNote: Adapts to psychic pressure, including automatic loss at zero Psionic. No benefit from staying out of combat.

cards.name: Hive Regent
cards.text: Once per your Battle phase, when at least three Creatures under your control attack, choose up to two of them to gain +1 Physical until end of turn.
cards.designNote: Wide attack payoff capped at two bonus damage.

cards.name: Apex Aberration
cards.text: Psionic X. If its ability roll is numeric 1 or 2, gain +2 Physical for the turn; if 4 or 5, gain +1 Psionic for the turn.
cards.designNote: Opposing Lock-On must weigh two different threats.

cards.name: Suture Architect
cards.text: During your Creation, once per turn, you may relocate one Equipment between this and another legal unit under your control, paying its move cost. If you do, this gains +1 Psionic until end of turn.
cards.designNote: Equipment integration without mid-declaration shuffling.

cards.name: Neural Interface
cards.text: When Stacked with a Creature, its X ability roll may be rerolled once; keep the new result.
cards.designNote: Reliability for biological risk, at a card cost.

cards.name: Alloy Symbiont
cards.text: After its Stack survives a blocked battle in which it lost a Cyber or Psionic battle, you may deplete P1 for Cyber or R1 for Psionic. Its non-Cyborg partner gains +1 permanent strength in that lost channel, if its type can use it. Choose at most one channel.
cards.designNote: Combat-tested augmentation for either faction; a permanent upgrade for Robots and a permanent buff for Creatures, not inherently a Mutation.

cards.name: Convergence Engine
cards.text: When forming a Stack, if you control both an untrapped Robot and an untrapped Creature, choose one: Calibrate its Physical die, or grant its partner +1 Physical until the Stack separates.
cards.designNote: Explicit payoff for genuine multi-faction board, not just splashing a Cyborg.

cards.name: Emergency Firewall
cards.text: In response to a Pulse that targets exactly one of your Robots or Cyborgs and would prevent it from attacking or defending, cancel that Pulse. Paid costs are not refunded.
cards.designNote: Broad defensive response against disabling effects rather than a dedicated answer to one card.

cards.name: Salvage Protocol
cards.text: Creation only. Remove one destroyed Robot from your discard. Replenish one depleted CU other than the CU paid for this card.
cards.designNote: Tempo not ramp; cannot refund itself.

cards.name: Modular Assembly
cards.text: Search your Battle Deck for an Equipment with printed total cost 2 or less and no burn cost. Reveal it and create it attached to a legal unit under your control without paying its cost. Shuffle.
cards.designNote: Operation; direct fabrication rather than a redundant, more expensive tutor.

cards.name: Repair Circuit
cards.text: Prevent the next 1 point of ability damage to one Robot or Cyborg under your control this turn.
cards.designNote: Flexible small prevention, not a combat win guarantee.

cards.name: Signal Jam
cards.text: Choose one Battle Unit under enemy control. It cannot use optional activated abilities until end of turn. Does not remove static abilities or mandatory rolls.
cards.designNote: Interrupts engines but does not cancel an already declared activation.

cards.name: Molting
cards.text: In response to a Power or unit ability targeting one Creature or Cyborg under your control for damage, that unit loses 1 Psionic until end of turn (must have at least 1). Prevent up to 2 damage from that effect to that unit.
cards.designNote: Sheds psychic function to survive injury; useful in multiple matchups.

cards.name: Forced Evolution
cards.text: Choose a Creature under your control. Roll red as an ability roll. Numeric odd: +2 Psionic; numeric even: +1 Physical. Until end of turn.
cards.designNote: Temporary forced response, not a Mutation. Power roll is not eligible for Lock-On.

cards.name: Cannibalistic Instinct
cards.text: Choose a Creature under your control. Cannibalize a different Creature or Cyborg under your control. The chosen Creature gains Physical equal to the consumed unit’s permanent Physical immediately before destruction until end of turn.
cards.designNote: Uncapped transfer; includes printed Physical and permanent modifications, excludes Equipment, temporary effects, damage, auras and Stack partners. Cost destroys a body; Pulse enables combat surprises.

cards.name: Brood Recall
cards.text: Creation only. Return up to two Creatures with printed total cost 1 from your discard to your hand.
cards.designNote: Card advantage, not free board presence.

cards.name: Unstable Carapace
cards.text: Choose a Creature under your control in a blocked battle. Roll red as an ability roll. Numeric 1–2: +1 Physical; 3–5: +1 Psionic. Until end of turn.
cards.designNote: Cheap risk with counterplay; no guaranteed major bonus.

cards.name: Crosslink
cards.text: During the Power window, choose one of your existing Stacks. It gains +1 Cyber and +1 Psionic until it separates.
cards.designNote: Flexible costs, no Physical damage burst.

cards.name: Emergency Separation
cards.text: During the Power window, split one of your Stacks. Choose one member to remain engaged; the other returns to your Lab depleted.
cards.designNote: Sacrifice combined power to preserve a body; no extra block.

cards.name: Interference Net
cards.text: Contain one unit under enemy control with printed Physical 2 or less. Free it at its owner’s next Cleanup.
cards.designNote: Short tempo effect; not a separate card type.

cards.name: Parasitic Snare
cards.text: Contain one unit under enemy control. At its owner’s next Cleanup, free it. If you control a Creature in your Lab that can grant abilities, the freed unit loses 1 Physical until end of that turn (minimum 1).
cards.designNote: Temporary opening; distinct from Grankor protection.

cards.name: Servo Harness
cards.text: +1 Physical for Robots or Cyborgs. Relocate — deplete P1.
cards.designNote: Efficient initial equipment; moving the harness costs tempo.

cards.name: Adaptive Membrane
cards.text: +1 Psionic for Creatures or Cyborgs. When its bearer is destroyed, you may return this Equipment to your hand instead of discarding it. Once per Battle phase.
cards.designNote: Preserves investment, but reattaching requires normal creation cost.

cards.name: Interface Plating
cards.text: +1 Physical for Cyborgs. While Stacked, its non-Cyborg partner may ignore the first 1 ability damage dealt to it each Battle phase. Relocate — deplete R/P 1.
cards.designNote: Flexible mixed build; relocation is paid.

cards.name: Carrion Foundress
cards.text: Once per Battle phase across your Carrion Foundresses, when this or its Stack survives and destroys one or more Battle Units under enemy control in Physical combat, choose one of those destroyed cards. You may create one Creature from your hand with printed total cost no greater than that card’s printed total cost. Waive its depletion costs; pay all its printed burn costs.
cards.designNote: Feeding payoff; no sum of Stack costs, no free burn, no extra combat assignment. Test 4-cost finisher and cheap body generation.
